body:
#AbhijeetDipke’s June 6 Protest: The #CockroachJantaParty Moves Offline

@abhijeet_dipke’s call for supporters to gather on June 6 and demand the resignation of Education Minister @dpradhanbjp marks an important moment in the evolution of the so-called “Cockroach Janta Party” movement. For the first time, a phenomenon that has largely existed online is attempting to test its strength on the streets.

The issues being raised by Dipke and his followers may well be genuine. Concerns about examinations, recruitment processes, transparency and accountability in public institutions resonate with many young Indians. Governments should never dismiss such grievances out of hand.

However, serious questions remain about the movement itself.

The extraordinary growth of the Cockroach Janta Party across social media platforms was anything but ordinary. Its follower counts exploded in a manner that appeared highly unusual and, to many observers, distinctly inorganic. Large numbers of bot-like accounts, coordinated amplification patterns and suspicious engagement metrics across platforms have led to persistent doubts about how much of the movement’s apparent popularity reflects real people rather than digital manipulation.

That does not automatically invalidate every concern raised by its supporters. But it does raise legitimate questions about who is driving the movement, how it achieved such rapid visibility, and whether its online strength accurately reflects real-world public support.

The June 6 protest will therefore be closely watched. Not only will it provide a clearer picture of the movement’s genuine grassroots reach, it will also test whether an online phenomenon can successfully transition into an organised offline force.

Recent developments in several countries across South Asia have demonstrated how digitally mobilised protest movements can quickly escalate beyond their original demands and, in some cases, turn confrontational or violent. For that reason alone, any government would be expected to monitor such gatherings carefully.

The challenge for authorities will be maintaining public order without overreacting. Excessive force or heavy-handed action risks elevating fringe figures into national symbols. At the same time, legitimate concerns about the origins, methods and objectives of the movement cannot simply be ignored.

June 6 may ultimately reveal whether the Cockroach Janta Party is a genuine mass movement, a social media mirage, or something in between. @CJP_2029 @Cockroachisback

सोनम वांगचुक वो गलती दोबारा से करने जा रहे हैँ जिसमें से वो पहले बडी मुश्किल से बाहर निकले थे.

Sonam wangchuk ने ऐलान किया है कि

 वो 6 जून को जंतर मंतर शिक्षा मंत्री धर्मेंद्र प्रधान के इस्तीफे के लिए CockroachJanta party के धरने में शामिल होंगे.

सवाल यहाँ ये उठता है कि क्या सोनम खुद इतने सक्षम नहीं हैँ वो धरना देकर किसी का इस्तीफा मांग सकें?

ताकि उनको हाईलाइट किया जा सकें.
मुझे उम्मीद है युवा इस जाल में नहीं फसेंगे 🙏

body:
Something doesn't add up.

The Cockroach Janta Party was launched around a specific grievance involving the CJI and the Education Minister. Yet, within weeks, its Chief Spokesperson is talking about entirely different issues:

• Culture of non-answerability
• Not holding press conferences
• Not talking to the media
• Suppression of independent voices

If these are now the central themes, then this movement appears to have evolved far beyond its original stated purpose.

That is precisely what concerns me.

A protest that begins with one issue but quickly shifts into a broader political narrative naturally raises questions about its real objectives. Citizens have every right to protest, but they also have every right to ask: What is the actual agenda here?

The sudden transition from a specific grievance to a full-scale critique of governance deserves scrutiny, not blind applause.

मुसलमानों !!

6 जून को कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी जंतर मंतर पर प्रोटेस्ट करेगी। मुसलमानों से गुजारिश है कि इस प्रोटेस्ट से दूर रहिएगा, बल्कि उस रास्ते से गुजरने की कोशिश भी मत कीजिएगा। अगर आपका घर उसे जगह के आसपास है तो एक दिन के लिए वह जगह ही छोड़ दीजिए।

100% उस दिन बवाल होगा और  हमेशा की तरह मुसलमान बली का बकरा बनाया जाएगा। बाकी लोग अपने घर चले जाएंगे लेकिन आप खालिद सैफ़ी, मीरान हैदर और उमर खालिद की तरह जेल जाएंगे। आप पर उन सभी धाराओं में मुकदमे दर्ज होंगे जिसमें आप 10 साल तक जेल से बाहर नहीं आ सकेंगे।

आपका घर बुलडोज किया जाएगा, आपकी दुकान छीन ली जाएगी ,आपके घर के बाहर महीनों पुलिस खड़ी रहेगी, आपका मीडिया ट्रायल होगा, आपका पाकिस्तान कनेक्शन बताया जाएगा। आपको आतंकवादी घोषित किया जाएगा।

और याद रखिए इसी पार्टी के लोग आपको पूछेंगे भी नहीं, जैसे दिल्ली दंगों में अरविंद केजरीवाल ने अपनी ही पार्टी के पार्षद ताहिर हुसैन से पल्ला झाड़ लिया था। ताहिर आज तक जेल में बंद है। आम आदमी पार्टी ने पलट कर ना देखा।

इस वक्त हमारी लड़ाई खुद को बचाने की है, सर्वाइवल की है। अपने काम पर ध्यान दीजिए,  अपने बच्चों की एजुकेशन पर फोकस कीजिए।

My two cents on what's going to happen in Delhi on Saturday, June 6, 2026.

@abhijeet_dipke, the founder of the @Cockroachisback, has announced to land in Delhi at 0800 Hrs that day. It is unlikely that the Modi govt will try to arrest him there, knowing the massive support the CJP is receiving from all sections of society. I'm not expecting a crowd of thousands to reach the airport to receive him. If they do make it there, the Modi govt will try to scatter them under the pretext of airport security issues. NO FORCE WILL BE USED & NO ARRESTS WILL BE MADE AT THE AIRPORT itself, given the heavy presence of foreign visitors and the world's eyes on this protest.

As per the announced plans, the CJP will then head to the Parliament Street PS to seek permission for a protest later that day at Jantar Mantar. Though JM is a designated space for protests and the police should grant permission, knowing Amit Shah well, the Delhi police will likely deny it, citing law & order issues and protocol rules for applying.

This is where story will unfold. The moment this news breaks, the protestors who have started arriving to join the protest, especially the angry students & Gen-Z masses, might sit in protest anyway. This will trigger a clash between the police and the protestors. The govt might use force against them. This is where they might arrest Abhijeet Dipke under the pretext of inciting the crowd to disrupt law & order and creating unrest in the country. The BJP’s pre-prepared toolkit will be launched to defame the CJP as a foreign-funded entity formed to create civil unrest in India. If that happens, the protest will immediately spread across the country and become the most massive movement since Independence.

If the CJP decides to postpone the protest due to the lack of permission, the Modi govt, together with its 'godi media' & IT cell, will start calling it a failed protest and label Dipke and others 'Darpok'. However, whether or not a clash takes place, the Modi govt will be closely gauging the strength of this online satirical party and the support it receives.

It is unlikely that the protest will be allowed to take place smoothly. Instead, there are chances that the govt may take another route by offering to hold a dialogue and giving false assurances, just as they did during the farmers' and the Ladakh protest. It will be interesting to see on what charges and at what stage they will arrest Abhijeet Dipke to weaken the party and the movement. However, this time it is not just Muslims, farmers, defense personnel, or bankers; it is a charged-up Gen-Z. THINGS ARE DEFINITELY NOT GOING TO BE EASY FOR MODI FROM NOW ON.

So, I suggest everyone joining the protest remain calm and not lose their temper. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Let them use force if they do; it will only strengthen the storm against this autocratic, shameless govt. To everyone else, whether you are a student, Gen-Z, or a parent; Hindu or Muslim; rich or poor; upper or lower caste; irrespective of your skin color, what you eat, what you wear, or what language you speak, HIT THE ROADS AND JOIN THE MOVEMENT. Those serving as honest bureaucrats, police, and defense forces should also join the protest for the sake of their future generations. Breaking News
2,600 unemployed youths, all supporters of the CJP, protesting for job regularisation and opposing amendments to recruitment rules.

Abhijeet Dipke : We demand the resignation of PM Modi. Dr Mansukh Mandaviya, the Union Minister of Labour and Employment should resign with immediate effect.

Saurav Ass... sorry, Dass : We stand with the protesters. Even if they did not obtain prior permission from the police, I see no reason why their demands should not be fulfilled.

Ashutosh Ranka : Where are the constitutional and democratic rights of the youth of India ? Modi must resign.

Reporter : Excuse me.......

Sonam Wangchuk : I will begin an indefinite hunger strike and continue protesting against this insensitive government until the demands of the youth are met.

Arvind Kejriwal, Manish Sisodia, and Sanjay Singh : We challenge the government at the Centre. You dare not stop this protest.

Reporter : Excuse me, sir. This particular protest was led by 2600 unemployed youths of Punjab at the PSPCL headquarters in Patiala. They were lathi charged and beaten with batons by the Punjab Police because they were protesting for jobs in your AAP ruled state.

A deep silence follows.
Abhijeet Dipke: Mmpfff !! I have to board my flight ...
Sonam Wangchuk : Err......I just remembered that I have to catch an Uber to Jantar Mantar.
Ashutosh Ranka : I better prepare for another press conference.
Kejriwal, Sisodia, and others: This is a conspiracy by the BJP and Modi to defame us !!

After 2 minutes.....the protectors and upholders of constitution and democracy and the party showing solidarity with the unemployed youth of India has scurried into their drains and garbage dumps ....at the mention of the word Punjab.

It's only a matter of time.

ONE DEMAND: RESIGNATION.
We were on the ground at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi today as Abhijeet Dipke , founder of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), addressed hundreds of student protestors and the media. The message from the crowd was unified: Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan must step down. Following widespread outrage over the NEET-UG paper leak scandal, disruptions in the CUET and SSC GD exams, and grading discrepancies within the CBSE Class 12 evaluation system.  The demonstration marks the first major offline mobilization for the CJP—a youth-led movement formed after a controversial courtroom remark by CJI Surya Kant comparing certain youth activists to "cockroaches and parasites." To reclaim the phrase, many students arrived today wearing cockroach masks and holding flowers, demanding systemic accountability for over 1 crore affected students nationwide.

body:
'Deep State' Dipke's Cockroach Protest Stands 
Exposed; Leftist Roaches Crawl Over Jantar Mantar

Roaches roasting under Delhi’s baking sun were roaring one line today — "Cockroaches never fear, never die."

That part is true. But there’s something else about cockroaches they’re not telling you.

Did you know a cockroach can survive without its head? Cut the head off, and it keeps walking for days — on pure instinct. It can’t eat. It can’t think. It just… keeps moving until it starves or rots from the inside.

That is exactly what we are watching today.

June 6, 2026. Jantar Mantar — that sacred feeding ground where India’s professional protestors have dined for decades. 

The Cockroach Janata Party had promised a mega youth revolution. NEET leaks. Exam scams. Dharmendra Pradhan’s resignation. Twenty-two million algorithm-engineered bots screaming fire across Instagram and X.

The Roach in Chief himself — Abhijeet Dipke — landed fresh off a flight from Boston, constitution in one hand, promises of flowers for the police in the other. They said the streets would burn. 

They said Gen-Z would rise. What actually showed up? A few hundred cockroaches at best. Not even two thousand. Outnumbered by Delhi Police and the bored media crew waiting for a spectacle that never arrived. 

The same old headless wonders – Samajwadi remnants, RJD ruffians, Congress leftovers, AAPtards, and the usual left radicals – are twitching their antennae, desperately sniffing for any scent of chaos.

These political cockroaches had their heads severed in 2014. Electoral heads. Power heads. The constitutional route to power was shut for them — not by any conspiracy, but by the repeated verdict of the Indian people. 

More than a decade out of power with zero realistic hope of returning through the ballot box. So what do they do? They keep twitching. 

They keep marching. They try to reattach their severed heads by plugging into fresh student anger — NEET leaks, exam scams, anything that hurts young people — and then coating that genuine grievance with the same old anarchist poison.

This is not new. This is the exact same script we saw in anti-CAA. The exact same script we saw in the farmers’ protest. Manufacture outrage, import professional andolanjeevis from SFI, AISA, and AISF, bring in the Dafli Gang to beat Umar Khalid-style rhythms, and then pray that the resulting chaos becomes so big that the constitutional order cracks. 

If you cannot win elections, trigger enough street fire that you can usurp power through the back door — exactly as their foreign masters and deep-state scriptwriters have taught them for years.

That is why Abhijeet Dipke flies in from Boston. That is why the same discredited AAPiyas suddenly discover “student outrage". 

That is why Sauraav Das, their spokesperson, lasts ten minutes in the Delhi sun before retreating under a tree with cold coffee in his hand – while still demanding the prime minister's resignation. 

These are not revolutionaries. These are parasites who cannot stand the heat of real sunlight or real accountability.

They keep saying, “We are not a planned party. This is pure students’ outrage.” But the moment the Dafli starts and the old slogans return, the mask slips. 

The same people who spent ten years crying only about Hindu-Muslim politics are now trying to turn every exam paper leak into a constitutional crisis. The hypocrisy is not even clever anymore. It is just pathetic.

And the youth? The real Gen-Z and millennials? They stayed home. Because twenty-two million followers were mostly bots. 

Because the people leading this circus have been discredited so many times that even teenagers can smell the rot. The real students of this country are busy preparing for the next exam, building their futures, and watching India rise — not waiting to be extras in someone else’s failed revolution.

Real accountability on NEET and exam leaks is necessary. Absolutely. But turning every grievance into another prolonged dharna to topple a democratically elected government? The people have seen this movie too many times. They are not buying tickets anymore.

The cockroaches will keep bumbling. They will survive the head cut for a few more days — maybe weeks. They will keep twitching on pure instinct, hoping the next manufactured outrage finally gives them the chaos they need. 

But without real public backing, without electoral legitimacy, without a head – starvation is inevitable. Infection has already begun.

This civilisational nation is not going to let a handful of scurrying roaches feast on manufactured outrage and turn it into unconstitutional anarchy. 

History has it: India does not rise on wishful anarchy. It never will.

The headless march has already begun to die. We are just watching the slow, inevitable end.

body:
History bears witness to the fact that those in power dread nothing more than individuals who ask questions without waving a political flag.

Today, the very youth who ask these uncomfortable questions have taken to the streets. Gathered at Delhi’s Jantar Mantar, these young minds are contemptuously being labeled as "TILCHATTE" by some, who are even callously talking about spraying HIT on them.

While the BJP’s frustration is understandable, why the hell are these Congressmen losing their minds and overstepping their bounds? The very youth you are abusing have held up a mirror today to the ruling party, the opposition, and the media alike.
 * **No political stage,**
 * **No constellation of big-shot leaders,**
 * **No electoral rallies,**
 * **No crowds herded into hired buses.**
Yet, thousands of youngsters stood their ground. Most of them were likely sitting on a scorching road, under a blazing sun, without fans or tents, enduring conditions like a furnace for the very first time in their lives.

Those who are undermining them or mocking them are not just insulting these protestors, they are mocking the entire Gen Z and the younger generation of this nation.

These are the very youth who have been raising their voices for years against **unemployment, paper leaks, recruitment scams, inflation, and a compromised media**. Yet, in response, they are mockingly branded as "TILCHATTE."

If this youth quietly tolerates everything, they are hailed as the "future of the nation," but the moment they demand accountability, they are reduced to pests.

When Sonam Wangchuk arrived at the venue, people immediately began painting him as the "New Anna Hazare." Such comparisons are merely a testament to their desperation. Even the Congress is mocking Sonam Wangchuk. They evidently have no respect even for those whom the Modi government jailed simply for speaking up for the betterment of this country.

Some are dismissing this gathering of young citizens as a mere "bubble," claiming that barely 100 to 200 people showed up. To those skeptics, let me say this: deny it all you want, but you cannot escape the reality that this is the boiling wrath of the youth. The anger was always there. Today, it simply erupted and found expression.

Even if it is a passing bubble, the youth desperately need a platform. Their rage and resistance should not be measured by mere headcount, but understood through the depth of their anguish.

The voice that echoed at Jantar Mantar today is not just a protest; it is the restlessness of a generation that no longer wants rhetoric, it demands answers.

Dismissing lakhs of young citizens of this country as "cockroaches" will not make the problems vanish. However, it *will* definitively prove that the establishment has absolutely no answers to their questions.
**Keep questioning.**
**Keep demanding answers.**

Because in a true democracy, a citizen’s greatest weapon will always be their voice.

तब उसकी माँ और बहन बहुत रो रही थी उन्हें लग रहा था यहां आते ही सरकार गिरफ्तार करवा देगी.

इसके बाद अभिजीत दीपके ने दमदार नारा दिया, 

• सरकार की तानाशाही नही चलेगी नही चलेगी.
• नही डरेंगे नही डरेंगे. 
• धर्म की राजनीति बंद करो, बंद करो

भीड़ से एक लड़की ने जोर से चिल्लाकर कहा, जातिवाद बंद करो, बंद करो. अभिजीत दीपके ने इस नारे को नजरअंदाज कर दिया.

सरकार को अभिजीत दीपके और कॉकरोच मूवमेंट से कोई खतरा नही है. इसी कारण आंदोलन की परमिशन मिली, पुलिस एस्कॉर्ट मिला.

कॉकरोच मूवमेंट से सबसे ज्यादा नुकसान कांग्रेस पार्टी को है. राहुल गांधी NEET पेपर लीक और CBSE को बड़ा मुद्दा बना रहे थे. इसी बीच कॉकरोच की तादाद बढ़ जाती है. कॉकरोच मूवमेंट का मूल अर्थ है राहुल गांधी ने अब तक जो किया वो नाकाफी है, वो अक्षम है.

Yesterday, thousands of us made history. Our peaceful protest at Jantar Mantar showed the government a trailer of what cockroaches are capable of when we unite. 

Most people who joined us yesterday had never participated in a protest before. But they felt emboldened by our collective presence to express their sheer anger and frustration at the education system. Change cannot happen if we don’t make our voices heard.

I want to thank each and every one of you who braved the hot summer sun, young kids and students included, and proved that a peaceful protest is our greatest strength. The government cannot touch a unified, peaceful movement. Us cockroaches don’t ever need to fear them.

But this doesn't end here. Dharmendra Pradhan has wronged an entire generation. If he is not removed or does not step down within the next 7 days, we will be forced to continue our protest on the ground.

I will address you all on an Instagram live later today. Stay tuned.

body:
Ritika Chandola Reached Jantar Mantar As An Unknown Cockroach In The CJP Protest And Exposed The Topi Media

What was the real motive behind the so-called Gen-Z protest? 

How did the Cockroach Janta Party's demonstration end up becoming little more than a hub for engagement farming? 

To find out, Ritika Chandola reached Jantar Mantar wearing a CJP mask herself. She interacted with several media channels, but the TRP-hungry "cap media" never even bothered to ask who was hiding behind the mask. Their only concern was that someone was speaking against the government something that conveniently fit their narrative. 

It didn't matter who was speaking; what mattered was that the Modi government was being criticized. The media showed little interest in students' concerns or the issues affecting young people. Their focus remained firmly on pushing their own agenda. In this video, discover what Ritika Chandola witnessed firsthand while posing as "Diksha" behind the cockroach mask.
Credit : OpIndia.

Double Standards in Handling Youth Protests?

In Patiala, Punjab (AAP-ruled): Unemployed ITI apprentice linemen (2600 Apprentice Lineman Union) were peacefully demanding jobs after apprenticeship. They sat outside PSPCL HQ for days. Police responded with lathi charge – youths injured (one reportedly lost an eye), 10+ detained, 160+ booked. All for seeking regular employment. https://t.co/oG5uWnTjYa 

Just days later in Delhi (BJP-ruled): #CJP (Cockroach Janata Party) protest at Jantar Mantar – massive youth turnout against NEET/CBSE paper leaks, demanding minister’s resignation. Some raised controversial/“anti-national” slogans, called for chaos in prep, yet Delhi Police granted permission, protest stayed peaceful, no lathi charge, no major crackdown. https://t.co/2uaUKYXyQd
 
Same country. Same youth frustration over jobs & future.
Different ruling parties → Different police response.

Why the selective silence from “youth activists” & big media on Punjab? Because the narrative doesn’t fit when it’s #AAP in power?
Unemployed youth deserve dialogue, not batons – regardless of state. Hypocrisy exposes the politics over people.

CJP Jantar Mantar पहुँची → और BJP ने चैन की साँस ली।

- Abhijeet Dipke US से उड़कर आए → क्योंकि उन्हें पता था, arrest नहीं होगी। Delhi Police ने airport पर ही protest की permission दे दी। Amit Shah की Delhi Police खुद से कुछ नहीं करती → यह permission ऊपर से आई।

- BJP का Andh-Bhakt vote bank अटल है → उसे CJP से कोई फर्क नहीं पड़ता। तो BJP को क्या डर?

- CJP का पूरा agenda सिर्फ दो चीज़ें → CJI का cockroach बयान और NEET। न fuel price rise, न shrinkflation, न Vote Chori, न SIR, न voter deletion → कुछ नहीं।

- NEET दोबारा होगा, students career में लग जाएंगे → और यह movement उसी तरह गायब होगी जैसे आई थी।

लाखों युवा जो असली मुद्दों पर सड़क पर उतर सकते थे → उनकी energy एक controlled, expiry-date वाले movement में खप रही है।

BJP ने opposition को नहीं → distraction को permission दी। 

अब सवाल यह है कि CJP के बाद कौन उठाएगा वो मुद्दे जो BJP को सच में डराते हैं? 🎯

दिल्ली के जंतर-मंतर पर 6 जून को कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के प्रदर्शन में शामिल हुई रोहतक के एक स्कूल की महिला गेस्ट टीचर सुलेखा दलाल को विभाग ने निलंबित कर दिया है। 

हालांकि आदेश पत्र में निलंबन का कारण नहीं लिखा है, लेकिन इस प्रदर्शन के अगले ही दिन उनसे फोन पर जवाब भी मांगा गया था।

ऐसे में निलंबन को इसी मामले से जोड़कर देखा जा रहा है। इधर, बहादुरगढ़ के सेक्टर-9 में रह रही शिक्षिका सुलेखा ने कहा कि कारण तो विभाग जाने, मगर पेपर लीक मामला उनके बेटे और युवाओं के भविष्य से जुड़ा विषय है। इस पर वे हार नहीं मानेंगी, चाहे कुछ भी हो जाए।

सुलेखा दलाल मूल रूप से बहादुरगढ़ के मेहंदीपुर डाबौदा से हैं और रोहतक के रैनकपुरा स्थित राजकीय मिडिल स्कूल में गेस्ट टीचर हैं। राजनीति से लेकर भजन गायन और सोशल मीडिया पर रील बनाने में भी सक्रिय रहती हैं।

रोहतक डीईईओ की ओर से उनके निलंबन आदेश जारी कर बीईओ ऑफिस हेडक्वार्टर तय किया है। बिना अनुमति हेडक्वार्टर न छोड़ने के आदेश हैं। 

इधर, शिक्षिका सुलेखा दलाल ने कहा कि पेपर लीक से उनके बेटे को भी परेशानी हुई है। मगर यह केवल मेरे बेटे नहीं बल्कि लाखों युवाओं से जुड़ा मामला है। इसमें आखिर तक लड़ाई लड़ेंगी।

Did you notice ???

How the CJP protest faded after Delhi Protest at Jantar Mantar ???

Thats because ......

1. Modi ji never acknowledged their presence.
2. Amit Shah gave them immediate permission to protest at Jantar Mantar.
3. Abhijeet Dipke's agenda of Victim card, Persecution Card falls flat on its face.
4. Those protesting against the CJP were removed from the protest site.
5. Clear message that the government is not anti protest or against FOE or criticism.
6. Unbridled permission to media to cover the event, even their allied media houses tacitly accepted on record, that a party with 22 Million followers had no ground presence.
7. Amit Shah followed Chanakya Niti. 
8. When your enemy tries to provoke a response from you, never respond to him the way he expects you to !!
9. Abhijeet Dipke was exposed by none other than himself at the protest sites. He had said that if Dharmendra Pradhan does not resign, the Delhi Protest would continue indefinitely.
10. By 3pm Abhijeet Dipke had himself abandoned the protest site.

They had expected a "Nepal like response", "fussi bomb" response bhi nahi mila.

🤯 BIG | Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijit Dipke leads his party to a massive protest on Day-3 at Delhi’s Jantar Mantar.

In the video, Dipke can be heard warning the police, who are allegedly seeking Aadhar cards of protestors from the site. Dipke warned them to stop doing that.

In the presence of a massive crowd, Dipke was heard addressing the police.

On the other hand, Dipke was previously heard saying that he would be arrested. However, it has been two days since, and Dipke is still protesting and not being arrested.

Dipke was also heard to have invited farmers to protest and join in the Cockroaches’ movement. However, no farmers have turned out so far.

With the re-NEET examination successfully conducted, Dipke’s protest continues to seek accountability from the Government over the paper leaks.

लेकिन नेहा भारती का एक बात को लेकर बहुत अफ़सोस हुआ ,

8 days of the CJP protest at Jantar Mantar have now been completed.

There are around 150 people present throughout the day (including YouTubers), but around 300 people show up during meal times.

Approximate daily food & refreshments:

-Breakfast: ₹100 × 300 = ₹30,000
-Lunch: ₹200 × 300 = ₹60,000
-Evening Snacks: ₹100 × 300 = ₹30,000
-Dinner: ₹200 × 300 = ₹60,000
-Fruits, Frooti & other snacks: ₹100 × 300 = ₹30,000

Food & refreshments total: ₹2,10,000/day

Other daily expenses:

-Tent & Stage: ₹3,000/day
-Mic & Sound System: ₹2,000/day
-Washroom Cleaning: ₹1,500/day
-Student Union: ₹200 × 150 = ₹30,000/day
-Drinking Water: 150 people × 5 bottles = 750 bottles × ₹20 = ₹15,000/day
-Cigarettes: ₹3,000/day

Other expenses total: ₹54,500/day

Estimated total per day: ₹2,64,500

Estimated total for 8 days: ₹21,16,000

As per sources, Mohammad Junaid runs a mobile repair shop, and Sardar Ji runs a catering service.

Can Junaid and Sardar really afford to spend over ₹21 lakh on their own?

असली कमिटमेंट ऑनलाइन शोर से नहीं मापा जाता - यह उन लोगों से पता चलता है जो गर्मी में पक्के इरादे के साथ खड़े रहते हैं, भले ही संख्या कम हो। दोगलापन सामने आ गया।

राहुल गांधी और NSUI नीट पेपर लीक पर बीजेपी सरकार को घेर रहे थे.

अरविंद केजरीवाल, अखिलेश यादव, ममता बनर्जी और अन्य विपक्षी पार्टियां भी पेपर लीक मुद्दे पर आंदोलन कर रही थीं.

पकी पकाई फसल बीच में कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी खाने आ गयी. विपक्षी पार्टियों के समर्थकों के बीच ऐसा संगठन है जो विपक्ष नेताओं के खिलाफ है.

कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के नेता अभिजीत दीपके बीजेपी सरकार के खिलाफ उतना मुखर नही हैं जितना होना चाहिए. अगर कल को कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी राजनीति में आती है तो नुकसान विपक्षी पार्टियों को ही होगा. बीजेपी इसी कारण इस आंदोलन को कुचल नही रही है.

Looks like the alleged rumours about #Wangchuk may be right.
Leaders from Ladakh showed little support to Wangchuk since they felt that their issues wrt Ladakh were in discussion with the Centre since long and close to some, if not complete solution.. Challenging the govt now did little to help their cause. 
 
A reluctant #Sonam disappointed with the support, not just at Jantar Mantar but even from Ladakh leaders, is visibly having issues with #Dipke and gang for changing the mood of the protest from - requesting to warning to abusing to manipulating to now turning it visibly political. Also, Dipke and others abandoning wangchuk for hours in the name of meetings, keeping him in the dark and sudden appearances of political leaders on stage without consulting with him has made Wangchuk realise that the protest is not serving his purpose or helping his image.

In all likelihood, wangchuk will pull the plug off his contribution to this naatak mandli very soon in the coming days.
 
There are a lot of cold exchanges happening behind the curtains... The lack of seriousness of the protestors who are more bothered about 'khane mein kya hai' than any concrete cause has also pissed Sonam off. 
He gave a call to #CJP supporters to send recorded videos of 1 day of annshann from home to show support to their #hungerktrike ... Not one came. The disinterest is evident.  

"Yeh hai badlav ka chehra? Khane peene gaane se aage koi kuch karna nahi chahta. Kab tak buffet laga lagakar motivate karenge inhe. Sab pointless hai ." - guess who said that.

A major scene unfolded at the CJP protest at Jantar Mantar today during dinner.

People were served roti with khichdi, and many got upset, asking, "What kind of combination is this?"

They were almost about to get into a physical confrontation with Junaid. But at the last moment, some CJP members stepped in and apologized, assuring everyone that it wouldn't happen again from tomorrow.

Only then did the crowd calm down. They gave a final warning that they wanted a better dinner from the next day, and only then did they somehow finish their khichdi and roti.

Latest Guardian Sob Story On Umar Khalid Is Another Indication That NEET Is Just A Mask

On 30th June, The Guardian published a sympathetic profile of Umar Khalid, presenting the accused in the larger conspiracy case related to the 2020 anti-Hindu Delhi Riots as one of India’s most prominent “political prisoners” and a victim of a government crackdown on dissent. Built around reflections on prison, fading hope, Dostoevsky and Bhagat Singh, the article largely avoided examining the prosecution’s case against him.

The article needs to be scrutinised not just for what it said, but also for what it deliberately left outside the frame. The publication came amid open support for Khalid from the leadership and supporters of the so-called Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), whose protests were launched around the NEET paper leak and youth issues. However, protesters and CJP supporters, both online and offline, have called for Umar Khalid to be freed.

Titled “‘Humanity is a privilege’: Umar Khalid on his six years in an Indian jail without trial”, The Guardian article was written by Hannah Ellis-Petersen, the publication’s Delhi correspondent who is known for her anti-India propaganda. In the article, she described Khalid as an activist, a left-wing rights campaigner and a fierce critic of Prime Minister Narendra Modi. She claimed that he had become a symbol of the alleged weaponisation of the judicial system against government opponents.

In a recent interview with Samdish Bhatia on Unfiltered by Samdish, Dipke claimed that he had kept his movement peaceful, Constitution-centric and difficult to discredit. Out of no where, Samdish remarked that his surname was not Khalid, to which Dipke said that had he been a Khalid, Saifi or Muslim, he would have been in jail. Through the remark, Dipke appeared to suggest that so-called Muslim “activists” such as Umar Khalid were imprisoned because of their religious identity, conveniently ignoring the serious criminal and conspiracy charges against them. The forceful insertion of Khalid’s reference was uncanny but gave the idea what exactly they were trying to do.

Spokesperson Saurav Das went further, describing the charges against Khalid as “false” and “frivolous” and calling his imprisonment a blot on India’s judiciary.

Another CJP spokesperson, Vijeta Dahiya, attempted to reduce the case against Khalid to a speech quoting Mahatma Gandhi and his presence in a WhatsApp group. When questioned about the larger conspiracy case and the more than 50 people killed during the Delhi Riots, Dahiya fell back on the argument that no trial had taken place and accused the journalist questioning him of being “godi media”.

The argument was framed as a defence of due process. Let the trial happen, punish him if he is guilty and release him if he is innocent. However, the same people repeatedly cited the absence of a conviction as proof that the charges were false. They simultaneously demanded that the court process be allowed to conclude and treated the fact that it had not concluded as a declaration of innocence.

The procedural history was also more complicated than the slogan “six years without trial” suggested. Khalid’s latest plea, which was submitted to the court on 6th June, the same day CJP launched its first protest in Delhi, identified itself as his third bail application. His first and second bail applications were dismissed, as were subsequent appeals before the Delhi High Court. His Special Leave Petition was dismissed by the Supreme Court in January 2026, followed by the dismissal of his review petition in April.

The application itself reproduced the Supreme Court’s observation that the case involved several accused persons, voluminous documentary and electronic evidence and accusations concerning a structured and continuing conspiracy. The court also said the record did not show that Umar Khalid and the other accused were in jail only because of prosecution delays or that they had played no role in causing those delays.

While a debate over prolonged pre-trial detention is legitimate in a broader context, in Umar Khalid’s case, the delay in the trial was not caused by the justice system but by the accused themselves. Umar Khalid and the other accused in the larger conspiracy case used every possible tactic to delay the trial and then used the delay as an excuse to seek bail. From repeated bail pleas to pleas seeking to prevent the trial from starting, there was enough evidence to show that India’s justice system was not the culprit behind the six-year-long delay in the trial.

CJP Protestors Called Umar Khalid Their Leader

Support for Khalid was also visible at CJP’s first major protest at Jantar Mantar on 6th June. One protester was filmed declaring, “Umar Khalid is our leader.” Another said that he supported Khalid and saw nothing wrong with doing so. A CJP supporter also described Khalid and Sharjeel Imam as potential future occupants of the country’s highest political offices.

body:
The lukewarm response that the Cockroach Janta Party founders are witnessing at Jantar Mantar are the signs of the times we live in. Maasive following on Insta and Fb does not translate into on ground support. The generation which follows you on social media, especially the one's born post 2000, will not be willing to hit the streets. Heck, they are not even willing to walk down the road to get their daily household needs, because Blinkit, Zomato, Swiggy and their fourth friend Amazon, are all there, at their service. 

If only Urban Company and Pronto had an option, where one could hire protestors on one's behalf to protest for a cause, then the dwindling prospects of Cockroach Janta Party would have got a massive boost, but as of now, that functionality is not provided, but you never know.

Second, the faces of this movement lack charisma and public connect. Abhijeet Dipke is no mass leader, like Arvind Kejriwal, his persona and his background does not make the person behind the screen go like 'Woah, he is the guy I am willing to take 1 day off from my office'. 

Saurav Das and the other fellow, who keeps dancing to songs of 1990's Bollywood are not even Twitter celebrities. Also why would the generation following them, born post 2000, vibe to songs of Bollywood movies of 90's and the era of 2000 to 2010.

I did enjoy their dance performance, but then I am not your target audience. Similarly for all of Sonam Wangchuk's achievements, he too is no Anna Hazare and India of 2026, is not India of 2012. Life in India has become more comfortable, while the income disparity remains, both these truths run parallel. 

The issue of NEET, Ethanol are the one's which the ruling government should be rightly questioned about and one can even see supporters of the current government taking them to task on these 2 major issues.

However, the fast unto death emotional blackmail type of protest is passe. It no longer appeals to the current generation, neither to the one's previous to them, who actually grew up watching such protests overturn governments of the day.

A few days back, came across a clip of my friend @Iyervval where he spoke about how we don't realize that how far India has come from the days of abject poverty and this is where the answer to the lack of response to CJP's Dharna Party lies.

More than anything else, it is the lack of imagination on behalf of CJP, and taking a traditional route, which finds itself a lost child in today's comfort at the drop of an app button playstore.

Meanwhile, it is activist and News influencer @tehseenp 's campaign highlighting the issue of Ethanol that is drawing more attention, where in the elected representatives of the day,are being grudingly forced to acknowledge the issue.

May be, just may be, CJP folks study what AIM and Tehseen are saying and take a leaf out of their book.

2026 is not 2012!

body: कायदे से उन ऐंकरों को जाना चाहिए था, जिनसे चैनल की पहचान है। अच्छा है इसी बहाने नए चेहरों को मौक़ा मिल जाता है। ऐसा लगता है कि संवाददाता से अनजाने में यह बात निकल गई होगी, क्योंकि 2014 के बाद से यही पैटर्न बना दिया गया है। धरना प्रदर्शन को सीधे देश विरोधी साज़िश से जोड़ दिया जाता है और नारों से डराया जाने लगता है। इसी का इतना भय हो गया है कि धरना प्रदर्शन के पहले ही लोग कहने लगते हैं कि विपक्ष से हम दूर हैं। यह समस्या कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी की नहीं, महिला कुश्ती खिलाड़ियों की भी थी, शायद उससे पहले किसान आंदोलन की। इस बार एक चेंज दिख रहा है। विपक्ष और धरना प्रदर्शन को लेकर झिझक टूटने लगी है। कई दल गए हैं। कांग्रेस ने भी नैतिक समर्थन दे दिया है। गोदी मीडिया यहाँ से क्या करेगा? कांग्रेस के समर्थन के बाद इस अनशन को मोदी के ख़िलाफ बड़ी साज़िश बताने लग जाएगा या मोदी सरकार से सवाल करेगा। अभिजीत ने पहले जो भी कहा हो मगर राहुल गांधी के सवाल को कैसे हैंडल करना है, यह बात अब समझने लगे हैं। इसीलिए नए लोगों से ख़ूब सवाल होने चाहिए। कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी से यह सवाल नहीं होता तो यह बदलाव नहीं आता। जनता की निगाह में आना, उसके भरोसे पर उतरना आसान काम नहीं है।

The Delhi Police has urged protestors at Jantar Mantar to vacate the site at the earliest.

A heavy deployment of Delhi Police personnel was seen at the protest site following Wangchuk’s hospitalisation.

The development comes two days ahead of a planned march to Parliament on July 20 by Wangchuk and his supporters.

On Friday(July 17), Abhijeet Dipke had alleged that Wangchuk was attacked at the protest site in Jantar Mantar.

quote_body:
PUBLIC ADVISORY 

In view of reports of a proposed march to Parliament by CJP on 20.07.2026 (Monday), Delhi Police hereby categorically clarifies  that no permission has been sought or granted for any such protest march/procession.

Prohibitory order under Section 163 BNSS (erstwhile section 144 CrPC) is in force in the New Delhi District. *Accordingly, protest marches, processions, demonstrations and assemblies of five or more persons are strictly prohibited*, except at the designated protest site at Jantar Mantar,  with prior permission.

As Parliament session is commencing from 20 July, strict security arrangements are in place to ensure public safety, security of protectees, and the protection of vital government installations.

Any person violating these prohibitory orders shall be liable for prosecution under Section 223 BNS and other applicable provisions of law.

Delhi Police appeals to all citizens to respect the law, refrain from participating in any unauthorised gathering or march, and cooperate in maintaining public peace, safety and security.
@LtGovDelhi @DelhiPolice @CJP_for_India

​बिहार की वर्तमान राजनीतिक परिस्थितियों को देखते हुए आज एक कड़े और मजबूत जनांदोलन की आवश्यकता है। मैं उनसे आग्रह करता हूँ कि वे बिहार आकर यहाँ की जनता की आवाज़ बनें और मुख्यमंत्री सम्राट चौधरी की सरकार को सत्ता से उखाड़ फेंकने का काम करें।
​इस परिवर्तन की लड़ाई में मेरी पार्टी जनशक्ति जनता दल और मेरे समर्थकों का पूर्ण और अटूट समर्थन उनके साथ रहेगा। बिहार के बेहतर भविष्य और जनहित के लिए जो भी कड़े कदम उठाने होंगे, उसमें हम कंधे से कंधा मिलाकर खड़े रहेंगे। @CJP_for_India @samrat4bjp @BJP4India

आशुतोष रांका ने कहा अगर योगी जी ये वीडियो देख रहे हैं तो उनसे कहना है की जुनैद भाई के परिवार वालों को तुरंत रिहा किया जाए!

और जुनैद भाई को जंतर मंतर छोड़ कर यूपी बुलाया जा रहा था इसी मामले में आज धर्मेंद्र प्रधान के इस्तीफे के बाद आशुतोष रांका ने जुनैद भाई के लिए भी आवाज उठाई और योगी को चैलेंज दिया!

चीफ जस्टिस के एक बयान से पैदा हुई कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी ने मोदी सरकार की चूलें हिला दी .  12 सालों में पहली बार एक आंदोलन ने एक मंत्री का इस्तीफा लेने के लिए मोदी को मजबूर कर दिया . 
देश भर में युवाओं के समर्थन ने इस आंदोलन को इतना विराट रुप दे दिया कि मोदी की सत्ता हिल गई . अगर आज इस्तीफा नहीं होता तो अगले दो तीन  दिन इस सरकार पर भारी पड़ने वाले थे . पता नहीं कितनी बड़ी तादाद में भागीदारी हो जाती . 
यक़ीनन ऐसे आंदोलन की पहल और शुरुआत करने के लिए @abhijeet_dipke बधाई के पात्र हैं . उनके सहयोगी @SauravDassss और @AshutoshRanka जैसे लड़कों ने लीड लेकर इतिहास बना दिया है . 
सोनम वांगचुक का अनशन पर बैठना , सरकार का उन्हें जबरन उठा ले जाना फिर जंतर मंतर पर लाठी चार्ज . इन सबने मिलकर देश के लाखों युवाओं को जगा दिया . 
देश की युवा शक्ति को नमन है .

🚨STATEMENT

We are deeply concerned by multiple reports reaching us of students and other protestors being targeted, detained, or arrested by various state agencies, particularly in Assam, West Bengal, and Bihar.

The Cockroach Janta Party had called off its nationwide protest only after the Government of India assured us that no punitive action would be taken against any protestor, either now or in the future, in any BJP-ruled or NDA-ruled states. The reports emerging from these states are therefore a matter of grave concern.

First, we wish to assure every protestor that our legal team is already coordinating with brilliant lawyers in the concerned states to secure the release of those detained and to extend all possible legal assistance. This has been happening from Day 1.

Second, we call upon the Government of India, particularly @JPNadda ji and @DrJitendraSingh ji, to immediately honour the assurance given to us by ensuring the release of those detained and by directing that no coercive or retaliatory action is taken against any protestor anywhere in the country. The FIRs registered ought to be withdrawn too.

The Government of India is also reminded of its commitment to furnish us the written guarantee in this regard by tomorrow, Tuesday, 28 July 2026.

Our decision to suspend the nationwide protest was taken in good faith and solely on the basis of the government’s assurance that it would stand by its word. Any departure from that assurance would not merely amount to a breach of trust with the Cockroach Janta Party but would also be a breach of public trust with lakhs of young Indians who chose dialogue over protests.

Such breach of trust will be completely unacceptable to the youth.

The Government of India is reminded that it derives credibility not from just making a promise, but from the promises they honour.

To the young protestors we say, hold on. We are with you. The CJP continues to closely monitor the situation and expects the Government of India and all BJP/NDA state governments to act with utmost urgency, responsibility, and good faith that the present circumstances demand. We demand that all detainees/arrestees be released immediately, and in any case by tomorrow, and that all FIRs be withdrawn immediately, failing which we shall take further necessary steps.

🚨URGENT STATEMENT🚨

The interim order passed by the Supreme Court of India in the batch of PILs related to the CJP protest must ring alarm bells across the country. In particular, Direction No. 4, which permits governments to proceed with existing FIRs and carry out investigations, raises extremely serious concerns.

This direction stands in direct contradiction to the solemn assurance and guarantee extended by the Government of India to the youth of this nation on 25 July 2026, namely, that the FIRs would be withdrawn and that no protester would be directly or indirectly targeted for participating in the peaceful movement.

It was on the strength of that solemn assurance, and in complete good faith, that the Cockroach Janta Party called off its nationwide protest.

We now have a credible apprehension that the Government of India and BJP-ruled states may seek to use and weaponise this order of the Bench led by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant to continue FIRs against individual protesters and subject them to great harassment. This was precisely our concern from day one: that courts could be used, directly or indirectly, to achieve political ends by targeting peaceful dissent.

Equally troubling is the fact that the interim order was not opposed by the government's lawyers, despite the Central Government being fully aware that talks/assurances with the CJP had continued until as recently as late last night and that a solemn agreement had already been arrived at on 25 July.

The court's uninformed order is therefore wholly unacceptable.

A solemn public assurance given to thousands of young students and protesters cannot be diluted, undermined, or rendered meaningless through subsequent legal developments, in a surreptitious manner. It only results in breach of public trust.

In any event, nothing in the interim order prevents the Government of India or the concerned BJP/NDA ruled State Governments from withdrawing the FIRs or deciding not to proceed against peaceful protesters, like done by Bihar and Assam governments. The power to withdraw or not pursue such cases continues to rest with the executive. The court has not mandated that governments must definitely continue with the FIRs. That would be a deliberate misreading. The Government must not invoke the Court’s order as a justification for reneging on the commitment it made on 25 July.

We therefore demand that the Government of India and the concerned BJP/NDA State Governments immediately place the terms of this solemn assurance before the Supreme Court in the pending proceedings so that there is complete transparency regarding the commitments already made to the youth of this country and so that the court can withdraw and make an informed order in the future.

The youth of India entered into this understanding in good faith. That good faith must not be betrayed. Institutions of constitutional importance must never be politicised and weaponised to not honour the guarantees.

The deadline for the Government of India to honour its guarantees expires today. We once again call upon it to fulfil every commitment it made: withdraw the FIRs, ensure that no protester is subjected to future punitive action, and honour both the letter and the spirit of the assurance that brought an end to the protest.

Failing this, and as previously declared, the Cockroach Janta Party will have no option but to resume its nationwide protest to protect the students and young protesters who stood up not for themselves alone, but for the future of this nation. A government that breaks its word cannot expect the youth to remain silent. If the guarantees are dishonoured, the streets of India will once again become the voice of its young.

जिस आंदोलन को लोग सिर्फ छात्रों का समझ रहे हैं, उसकी सच्चाई कुछ और ही है! मैं एक सीक्रेट टूलकिट फाइल शेयर कर रहा हूँ, जिसमें यह दावा किया गया है कि 'कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी' को भारत में सपोर्ट करने वाले अरविंद केजरीवाल जी, वकीलों, डॉक्टरों और NGOs के नाम-नंबर दर्ज हैं। साथ ही कुछ मीडिया हाउसेज व इन्फ्लुएंसर्स भी इसे कवर कर इसे सही ठहराने में लगे हैं।

यह फाइल सिर्फ आप लोगों के साथ इसलिए शेयर करी जा रही है ताकि आप भी हकीकत को जान सकें।

भारत में बैठे इन लोगों के पीछे विदेशी धरती के कौन से बड़े आका हैं, वे भी जल्द सामने आएँगे!

यह फाइल विदेशी धरती से मुझ तक पहुँची है। इस फाइल को न मैंने बनाया है, न ही इसमें मैंने कोई छेड़खानी की है। अगर किसी को भी लगता है कि इसमें नाम गलत है, तो वे सरकार से इसकी जाँच की अपील करें। मेरे पास इसका मेटाडेटा, डिजिटल ट्रैक्स और टाइम ज़ोन ओरिजिन पूरी तरह सुरक्षित है। मैंने सिर्फ भारत की जनता के साथ इसे शेयर करके अपना फर्ज निभाया है।

⚠️ सख्त चेतावनी: फाइल के साथ छेड़छाड़ करना, नाम जोड़ना या हटाना कानूनी अपराध है। ऐसा करने वाले पर कानूनी कार्रवाई होगी।

पहली बार इंस्टाग्राम और फेसबुक पर हुआ FIR

PM मोदी के मॉर्फ्ड फोटो पर एक्शन, इंस्टा फेसबुक पर FIR दर्ज।

कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के प्रदर्शन के दौरान सोशल मीडिया पर प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी को लेकर मॉर्फ्ड और आपत्तिजनक सामग्री साझा करने के मामले में हैदराबाद साइबर क्राइम पुलिस ने बड़ी कार्रवाई की है।

पुलिस ने फेसबुक और इंस्टाग्राम के कई अकाउंट संचालकों के साथ-साथ Meta के इंडिया हेड के खिलाफ भी मामला दर्ज किया है।

पुलिस का कहना है कि शिकायतों के आधार पर जांच शुरू कर दी गई है और आरोपियों की पहचान की जा रही है।
